layout.hierarchy: Title is largest and boldest (red). The two-panel diagram is the visual dominant due to size and color density. Callout boxes are medium-weight bold text in colored fills; diagram-internal labels are the smallest text. Red is used for emphasis (title, arrows, Q circles, highlighted words).

visual_elements.description: Transformer architecture in two side-by-side rounded panels. LEFT PANEL 'Encoder' (peach fill, green border, red italic label top-left), bottom-to-top: text 'Inputs' with a thick red up-arrow beneath; arrow to pink rounded box 'Input Embedding'; arrow to a ⊕ circle fed by a sine-wave circle icon, labeled 'Positional Encoding' (label to the left); arrow into a large brown rounded container (encoder block) holding bottom-to-top: orange box 'Multi-Head Attention' with three small circles below it — V (blue), K (blue), Q (red); tan box 'Add & Norm'; darker tan box 'Feed Forward'; tan box 'Add & Norm'. Gray circle 'Nx' with loop arrow sits at the left of the container. Output arrow exits the container top and routes right into the decoder panel. RIGHT PANEL 'Decoder' (light green fill, green border, green italic label top-right), bottom-to-top: text 'Outputs (shifted right)'; arrow to green box 'Output Embedding'; ⊕ circle with sine-wave icon labeled 'Positional Encoding' (label to the right); arrow into a large light-green rounded container (decoder block) holding bottom-to-top: green box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' with V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) circles; tan box 'Add & Norm'; orange box 'Multi-Head Attention' with V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) circles — the V and K here receive arrows from the encoder output; tan box 'Add & Norm'; darker green box 'Feed Forward'; tan box 'Add & Norm'. Gray circle 'Nx' with loop arrow at the right of the container. Arrow up to tan box 'Linear', then tan box 'Softmax', then text 'Output Probabilities' at the very top; a thick red up-arrow stands at the top-left inside the decoder panel.

Semi-transparent yellow rectangle with a red dashed border highlighting the encoder-output-to-decoder cross-attention region: it spans the gap between the two panels, covering the top of the encoder block output and the V,K,Q circles feeding the decoder's second 'Multi-Head Attention'.
visual_elements.position: center of diagram, straddling the Encoder/Decoder panel boundary at ~45%-60% height

imagery: No photographs. Only schematic icons: two sine-wave-in-circle positional encoding symbols and two ⊕ addition circles, drawn in thin dark outline style within the diagram panels.
typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title is bold, ~36-40pt, red, title-case with en dash. Callout box text is bold, ~14-18pt, centered, some words colored for emphasis ('Last', 'ALL' in red; '(V,K,Q)' tuples in blue). 'Encoder' and 'Decoder' panel labels are bold italic. Diagram-internal labels are small (~8-10pt), regular weight, dark gray/black. Slide number is bold inside a yellow circle. No all-caps except 'ALL' which is emphasized uppercase.
